headline: Margins expand on stronger aerospace demand
summary_short: Hexcel posted Q2 FY2026 revenue of $529.3M (+8.0% y/y) and diluted EPS of $0.64 (+276.5% y/y), as gross margin expanded to 26.1% from 22.8% on higher sales leverage across both segments.
summary_long: Revenue rose 8.0% y/y to $529.3M as Composite Materials sales grew 7.2% on stronger Boeing/Airbus commercial aerospace demand (Airbus A350, Boeing 787, narrowbody programs), partly offset by a 7.7% Defense/Space decline tied to the September 2025 Austrian industrial divestment; Engineered Products rose 11.5% on higher commercial aerospace sales. Gross margin expanded to 26.1% from 22.8% y/y on higher sales leverage, lifting operating income to $72.6M from $30.0M and net income to $49.3M from $13.5M. Diluted EPS reached $0.64, up from $0.17, aided by a lower diluted share count (76.5M vs 80.6M). Cash stood at $62.2M with $959.4M total debt after refinancing into new 4.9% senior notes; the board declared a $0.18/share dividend, flat q/q.

drivers.explanation: Company attributes the quarter to higher sales and gross margins across both segments, driven by commercial aerospace demand, partially offset by higher interest expense from increased average borrowings.

Composite Materials sales +7.2% y/y on higher Boeing/Airbus commercial aerospace demand, partly offset by a 7.7% Defense/Space decline from the September 2025 Austrian industrial divestment; Engineered Products +11.5% y/y on higher commercial aerospace sales.
Company attributes the 330bp y/y improvement (26.1% vs 22.8%) to higher sales leverage.
MD&A states operating income for both the quarter and six months was favorably impacted by the higher sales and gross margins.
Tracks the operating-income gain, partially offset by higher interest expense on increased average borrowings and a higher tax provision ($11.4M vs $8.3M y/y).
Diluted EPS rose in line with net income growth ($49.3M vs $13.5M y/y), amplified by a lower diluted share count (76.5M vs 80.6M y/y).
Board declared the same $0.18/share dividend on July 29, 2026 as it declared for Q1 2026, up from $0.17/share in Q2 2025.
